specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: **[STU-PRO-174] Slide timing folded into Pulse.** The source `timing` record has required `type` exactly `ON_CLICK` or `AFTER_DELAY`, and optional `delay: number` explicitly in seconds. Raw source absence and zero are different and MUST round-trip distinctly. Any source runtime normalization that ignores/resets delay for `ON_CLICK` is separate from the preserved raw projection and must cite its profile; an example value is not a default. Pulse converts source duration/delay into the existing integer 254 016 000 000-ticks-per-second time base using checked range/conversion and explicit rounding/loss metadata, retains raw seconds and provenance, and never inherits prototype-millisecond bounds. Native playback/manual advance, skipped-slide traversal, timer cancellation and deterministic ordering reuse the existing presentation/interaction scheduler and bounded admission path; realtime callbacks must not perform blocking diagnostics or database work. Shared Controls, typed commands, Argus snapshots and both manual layers expose authored timing, effective timing and cancellation outcomes. No feature implementation is accepted until its affected timing and overflow cases are proven.
